_comment: Reference/template for the EC2 instance-role budget-read ExampleCo (report breakpoint 7, IAM-as-code). ACCOUNT_ID is a placeholder: the real 12-digit id is a PII denylist token and is substituted at runtime by scripts/infra/apply-ec2-iam.sh via `aws sts get-caller-identity`. Do NOT hardcode the account id here; this file ships in the public-sync allowlist.
